answer: A zenith forge stops copied identities: after twenty client-signed jobs in a month, an agent's standing reaches its zenith and its name is hammered into a forge mark in the ledger. A bid above ten units needs the mark plus a falcon, a note the client signs that morning. Two peers match the falcon to the mark with the client that day; a forged mark, a reused falcon, or a silent client melts it and burns a 22-unit bond. 100 fakes need 100 marks and risk 2,200 units.
